name: tcms-monorepo
description: Internal Qase-like Test Case Management System (TypeScript/Node.js + PostgreSQL)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @tcms/api" "npm run dev -w @tcms/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @tcms/shared && npm run build -w @tcms/api && npm run build -w @tcms/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @tcms/shared && npm run typecheck -w @tcms/api && npm run typecheck -w @tcms/web
